comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The pre-delay knob runs 0 to 1 and is used as 500 raised to that power in milliseconds, so it is 1ms at the bottom, about 22ms at its default of 0.5 and 500ms at the top; the maker named the parameter Time and lettered the panel Pre-Delay. The base delay lengths come from DelayUtils::generateDelayLengths starting at 45ms with a ratio of 1.1, rounded to primes, and the size knob scales all of them. The two T60 knobs set the low and high bands of a first-order shelving filter in each delay line whose crossover is fixed at 800Hz; low defaults to 1 second and high to half a second. The delay count knob is not snapped: it is a continuous 1 to 16 cast to an integer.
